RequestService.Query: SELECT A.HTID, A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, A.HTDGREE, A.QACD, NVL(A.ESTRESULTCD,' ') AS ESTRESULTCD, NVL(A.ESTOPINION,' ') AS ESTOPINION, NVL(A.RTOPINION,' ') AS RTOPINION, NVL(A.ESTREGISTDT,' ') AS ESTREGISTDT, NVL(A.RTREGISTDT,' ') AS RTREGISTDT, NVL(A.ESTREGISTID,' ') AS ESTREGISTID, NVL(A.PROCESS_DATE,' ') AS PROCESS_DATE, NVL(A.RT_PROCESS_DATE,' ') AS RT_PROCESS_DATE, NVL(A.QAOPINION,' ') AS QAOPINION, NVL(A.CMPL_YN, ' ') AS CMPL_YN, NVL(A.QC_PASS_RT,' ') AS QC_PASS_RT, A.EST_ITEM_VER, A.SC_CD_ID, NVL(A.EVAL_SCOR,' ') AS EVAL_SCOR FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY A, (SELECT A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, MAX(REG_DT) AS REG_DT FROM TSOWN.TB_INSU_PLAN_MAST M, TSOWN.TB_APP_ACT_HIST A WHERE M.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND A.APP_ACT = '120' GROUP BY A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO) B WHERE A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO -- AND SUBSTR(B.REG_DT, 0,6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7, 'YYYYMM') AND SUBSTR(B.REG_DT, 0,6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM') -- AND SUBSTR(B.REG_DT, 6) >= '201801'

MERGE tb_pre_est_history AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( HTID = ?HTID AND CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND HTDGREE = ?HTDGREE AND QACD = ?QACD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ESTRESULTCD = ?ESTRESULTCD, ESTOPINION = ?ESTOPINION, RTOPINION = ?RTOPINION, ESTREGISTDT = ?ESTREGISTDT, RTREGISTDT = ?RTREGISTDT, ESTREGISTID = ?ESTREGISTID, PROCESS_DATE = ?PROCESS_DATE, RT_PROCESS_DATE = ?RT_PROCESS_DATE, QAOPINION =?QAOPINION, CMPL_YN =?CMPL_YN, QC_PASS_RT = ?QC_PASS_RT, EST_ITEM_VER = ?EST_ITEM_VER, SC_CD_ID = ?SC_CD_ID, EVAL_SCOR = ?EVAL_SCOR WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( HTID ,CON_ENT_DGN_NO ,HTDGREE ,QACD ,ESTRESULTCD ,ESTOPINION ,RTOPINION ,ESTREGISTDT ,RTREGISTDT ,ESTREGISTID ,PROCESS_DATE ,RT_PROCESS_DATE ,QAOPINION ,CMPL_YN ,QC_PASS_RT ,EST_ITEM_VER ,SC_CD_ID ,EVAL_SCOR ) VALUES ( ?HTID ,?CON_ENT_DGN_NO ,?HTDGREE ,?QACD ,?ESTRESULTCD ,?ESTOPINION ,?RTOPINION ,?ESTREGISTDT ,?RTREGISTDT ,?ESTREGISTID ,?PROCESS_DATE ,?RT_PROCESS_DATE ,?QAOPINION ,?CMPL_YN ,?QC_PASS_RT ,?EST_ITEM_VER ,?SC_CD_ID ,?EVAL_SCOR );

SELECT TM_TMR_ID AS USER_ID, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') AS MONTH, ROUND(AVG(CAST(NVL(B.EVAL_SCOR,0) AS FLOAT)),0) AS BEF_SCORE FROM (SELECT M.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, M.TM_TMR_ID, REG_DT FROM TSOWN.TB_INSU_PLAN_MAST M, (SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO, MAX(REG_DT) AS REG_DT FROM TSOWN.TB_APP_ACT_HIST WHERE APP_ACT = '120' GROUP BY CON_ENT_DGN_NO) A WHERE M.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND TM_TMR_ID IS NOT NULL -- AND MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR('20180430',0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REG_DT,0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD')) = 0 AND MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REG_DT,0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')||'01','YYYYMMDD')) = 0 ) A, (SELECT DISTINCT A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, NVL(A.EVAL_SCOR,0) AS EVAL_SCOR FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY A, (SELECT MAX(HTDGREE) AS HTDGREE , CON_ENT_DGN_NO FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY GROUP BY CON_ENT_DGN_NO) B WHERE A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND A.HTDGREE = B.HTDGREE AND QACD = '01' AND (A.EVAL_SCOR IS NOT NULL OR A.EVAL_SCOR <> '') ) B WHERE A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO GROUP BY A.TM_TMR_ID ORDER BY A.TM_TMR_ID

MERGE ms_bef_est_score AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( USER_ID = ?USER_ID AND MONTH = ?MONTH) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET BEF_SCORE = ?BEF_SCORE, REG_ID = 'SYSTEM', REG_DATE = format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss'), CHG_ID = 'SYSTEM', CHG_DATE = format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( USER_ID ,MONTH ,BEF_SCORE ) VALUES ( ?USER_ID ,?MONTH ,?BEF_SCORE );

INSERT INTO ms_xcron_service_log ( SERVICE_IP, SERVICE_NAME, START_DATETIME, END_DATETIME, EXECUTE_TIME, START_DATE, START_TIME, PROC_RSLT, ERR_MSG, PROC_FILECNT ) VALUES ( ?service_ip, ?service_name, ?start_date, ?end_date, ?execute_time, SUBSTRING(?start_date, 1, 8), SUBSTRING(?start_date, 9, 6), ?proc_rslt, ?err_msg, ?proc_filecnt )

SELECT GROUP_CD AS DEPT_CD, GROUP_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, GROUP_TYPE AS DEPT_TYPE, CASE GROUP_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN 0 WHEN '02' THEN 1 WHEN '03' THEN 2 WHEN '04' THEN 3 ELSE NULL END AS DEPT_LEVEL, NVL(HR_GROUP_CD,' ') AS UPPER_DEPT, CASE CLOSE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 'N' WHEN 'N' THEN 'Y' END AS USE_YN, ' ' AS SORT_NO, REGIST_ID AS REG_ID, REGIST_DATE AS REG_DATE, REGIST_ID AS CHG_ID, REGIST_DATE AS CHG_DATE, NVL(TREATYHQCD, ' ') AS ORG1_CD, NVL(TREATYBRHCD, ' ') AS ORG2_CD, NVL(TREATYDEPTCD, ' ') AS ORG3_CD, ' ' AS ORG4_CD FROM TSOWN.TB_GROUP_INFO WHERE REGIST_DATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date -- WHERE ROWNUM BETWEEN 1 AND 10 -- WHERE REGIST_DATE BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180927' -- WHERE REGIST_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2, 'YYYYMMDD')

MERGE ms_dept AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( DEPT_CD = '?DEPT_CD') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DEPT_NAME = ?DEPT_NAME, UPPER_DEPT = ISNULL(?UPPER_DEPT,' '), ORG1_CD = ISNULL(?ORG1_CD,' '), ORG2_CD= ISNULL(?ORG2_CD,' '), ORG3_CD = ISNULL(?ORG3_CD,' '), ORG4_CD = ISNULL(?ORG4_CD,' '), DEPT_TYPE = ?DEPT_TYPE, DEPT_LEVEL = CONVERT(INT,?DEPT_LEVEL), USE_YN = ?USE_YN, REG_ID = ?REG_ID, REG_DATE = ?REG_DATE, CHG_ID = ?CHG_ID, CHG_DATE = ?CHG_DATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( DEPT_CD, DEPT_NAME, UPPER_DEPT, ORG1_CD, ORG2_CD, ORG3_CD, ORG4_CD, DEPT_TYPE, DEPT_LEVEL, USE_YN, REG_ID, REG_DATE, CHG_ID, CHG_DATE ) VALUES ( ?DEPT_CD, ?DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(?UPPER_DEPT,''), ISNULL(?ORG1_CD,''), ISNULL(?ORG2_CD,''), ISNULL(?ORG3_CD,''), ISNULL(?ORG4_CD,''), ?DEPT_TYPE, ?DEPT_LEVEL, ?USE_YN, ?REG_ID, ?REG_DATE, ?CHG_ID, ?CHG_DATE );

SELECT CASE CODETYPE WHEN 'SYS057' THEN 'SYS002' END AS CODE_TYPE, CODE AS CODE_ID, CODENAME AS CODE_NAME, NVL(ETCCODE1,' ') AS ETC1, NVL(ETCCODE2,' ') AS ETC2, NVL(ETCCODE3,' ') AS ETC3, NVL(ETCCODE4,' ') AS ETC4, NVL(SORTKEY, 0) AS SORT_KEY FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE IN ('SYS057') AND CODE <> '000000'

MERGE ms_codebook AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( CODE_TYPE = ?CODE_TYPE AND CODE_ID = ?CODE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CODE_NAME = ?CODE_NAME, ETC1 = ?ETC1, ETC2 = ?ETC2, ETC3 = ?ETC3, ETC4 = ?ETC4, SORT_KEY = CASE WHEN ?SORT_KEY = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, ?SORT_KEY) END WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( CODE_TYPE ,CODE_ID ,CODE_NAME ,ETC1 ,ETC2 ,ETC3 ,ETC4 ,USE_YN ,SORT_KEY ) VALUES ( ?CODE_TYPE ,?CODE_ID ,?CODE_NAME ,?ETC1 ,?ETC2 ,?ETC3 ,?ETC4 ,'Y' ,CASE WHEN ?SORT_KEY = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, ?SORT_KEY) END );

SELECT U.USERID AS USER_ID, U.USERID AS EMP_NO, U.USERNAME AS USER_NAME, NVL(U.CTIAGENTID, 0 )AS CTI_AGENT_ID, CASE WHEN U.TREATYDEPTCD IS NOT NULL THEN TREATYDEPTCD WHEN U.TREATYBRHCD IS NOT NULL THEN TREATYBRHCD ELSE U.TREATYHQCD END AS DEPT_CD, NVL(U.TEAMCD,' ') AS TEAMCD, NVL(U.TREATYHQCD,' ') AS TREATYHQCD, NVL(U.TREATYHQNM,' ') AS TREATYHQNM, NVL(U.TREATYBRHCD, ' ') AS TREATYBRHCD, NVL(U.TREATYBRHNM,' ') AS TREATYBRHNM, NVL(U.TREATYDEPTCD,' ') AS TREATYDEPTCD, NVL(U.TREATYDEPTNM,' ') AS TREATYDEPTNM, NVL(U.LINE_NO , 0) AS LINE_NO, ' ' AS LEVEL_CD, ' ' AS FUNCTION_CD, NVL(U.JOB_GRADE,' ') AS JOB_CD, NVL(U.USERGROUPCD,' ') AS WORK_GROUP_CD, NVL(U.USERLEVEL,' ') AS USER_GRADE_CD, NVL(U.USERGROUPCD,' ') AS USER_GROUP_CD, NVL(C.OPEN_INPUT_DATE,' ') AS ENTER_DATE, NVL(C.LEAVEDATE,' ') AS RETIRE_DATE, NVL(U.CALLAUTH,' ') AS CALLAUTH, NVL((CASE WHEN C.OPEN_INPUT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND C.LEAVEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(LEAVEDATE,0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(OPEN_INPUT_DATE,0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'))+1 WHEN C.OPEN_INPUT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND C.LEAVEDATE IS NULL THEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM')||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(OPEN_INPUT_DATE,0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'))+1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS WORK_MONTH, CASE WHEN C.LEAVEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS USE_YN, NVL(U.REGISTID,' ') AS REGISTID, NVL(U.REGISTDATE,' ') AS REGISTDATE, NVL(U.REGISTTIME,' ') AS REGISTTIME, NVL(U.CHG_ID,' ') AS CHG_ID, NVL(U.CHGDATE,' ') AS CHGDATE, NVL(U.CHGTIME,' ') AS CHGTIME, NVL(U.SSOLOGINID,' ') AS SSOLOGINID, NVL(U.PASSWORD,' ') AS PASSWORD, ' ' AS PWD_CHG_DATE, ' ' AS PWD_RECENT1, ' ' AS PWD_RECENT2, 0 AS PWD_ERR_CNT FROM TSOWN.TB_USER U, TSOWN.TB_TMR_ID_CREATE C WHERE U.USERID = C.USERID(+) AND (U.CHGDATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date OR U.REGISTDATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date) -- AND (U.CHGDATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') OR U.REGISTDATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ) -- AND (U.CHGDATE BETWEEN '20181201' AND '20181204' OR U.REGISTDATE BETWEEN '20181201' AND '20181204') -- AND (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') - U.CHGDATE = 0 OR TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') - U.REGISTDATE = 0) --- 새벽에 돌면 -1, 밤에 돌면 SYSDATE -- AND U.USERID = '92016068' -- AND (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-14,'YYYYMMDD') - U.CHGDATE = 0 OR TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-14,'YYYYMMDD') - U.REGISTDATE = 0) --- 테스트용 -- AND (U.CHGDATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') OR U.REGISTDATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'))

SELECT CODETYPE AS CODE_TYPE, CODE AS CODE_ID, CODENAME AS CODE_NAME, NVL(ETCCODE1,' ') AS ETC1, NVL(ETCCODE2,' ') AS ETC2, NVL(ETCCODE3,' ') AS ETC3, NVL(ETCCODE4,' ') AS ETC4, NVL(SORTKEY, 0) AS SORT_KEY FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE IN ('EST312') AND CODE <> '000000'

MERGE ms_codebook AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( CODE_TYPE = ?CODE_TYPE AND CODE_ID = ?CODE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CODE_NAME = ?CODE_NAME, ETC1 = ?ETC1, ETC2 = ?ETC2, ETC3 = ?ETC3, ETC4 = ?ETC4, SORT_KEY = CASE WHEN ?SORT_KEY = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, ?SORT_KEY) END WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( CODE_TYPE ,CODE_ID ,CODE_NAME ,ETC1 ,ETC2 ,ETC3 ,ETC4 ,USE_YN ,SORT_KEY ) VALUES ( ?CODE_TYPE ,?CODE_ID ,?CODE_NAME ,?ETC1 ,?ETC2 ,?ETC3 ,?ETC4 ,'Y' ,CASE WHEN ?SORT_KEY = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, ?SORT_KEY) END );

MERGE ms_usermaster AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( USER_ID = ?USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET EMP_NO = ?EMP_NO, USER_NAME = ?USER_NAME, CTI_AGENT_ID = (CASE WHEN ?CTI_AGENT_ID = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ?CTI_AGENT_ID END), DEPT_CD = ?DEPT_CD, TEAMCD = ?TEAMCD, TREATYHQCD = ?TREATYHQCD, TREATYHQNM = ?TREATYHQNM, TREATYBRHCD = ?TREATYBRHCD, TREATYBRHNM = ?TREATYBRHNM, TREATYDEPTCD = ?TREATYDEPTCD, TREATYDEPTNM = ?TREATYDEPTNM, LINE_NO = (CASE WHEN ?LINE_NO = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ?LINE_NO END), LEVEL_CD = ?LEVEL_CD, FUNCTION_CD = ?FUNCTION_CD, JOB_CD = ?JOB_CD, WORK_GROUP_CD = ?WORK_GROUP_CD, USER_GRADE_CD = ?USER_GRADE_CD, USER_GROUP_CD = ?USER_GROUP_CD, ENTER_DATE = ?ENTER_DATE, RETIRE_DATE = ?RETIRE_DATE, CALLAUTH = ?CALLAUTH, WORK_MONTH = (CASE WHEN ?WORK_MONTH = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ?WORK_MONTH END), USE_YN = ?USE_YN, REGISTID = ?REGISTID, REGISTDATE = ?REGISTDATE, REGISTTIME = ?REGISTTIME, CHG_ID = ?CHG_ID, CHGDATE = ?CHGDATE, CHGTIME = ?CHGTIME, SSOLOGINID = ?SSOLOGINID, PASSWORD = ?PASSWORD, PWD_CHG_DATE = ?PWD_CHG_DATE, PWD_RECENT1 = ?PWD_RECENT1, PWD_RECENT2 = ?PWD_RECENT2, PWD_ERR_CNT = ?PWD_ERR_CNT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( USER_ID ,EMP_NO ,USER_NAME ,CTI_AGENT_ID ,DEPT_CD ,TEAMCD ,TREATYHQCD ,TREATYHQNM ,TREATYBRHCD ,TREATYBRHNM ,TREATYDEPTCD ,TREATYDEPTNM ,LINE_NO ,LEVEL_CD ,FUNCTION_CD ,JOB_CD ,WORK_GROUP_CD ,USER_GRADE_CD ,USER_GROUP_CD ,ENTER_DATE ,RETIRE_DATE ,CALLAUTH ,WORK_MONTH ,USE_YN ,REGISTID ,REGISTDATE ,REGISTTIME ,CHG_ID ,CHGDATE ,CHGTIME ,SSOLOGINID ,PASSWORD ,PWD_CHG_DATE ,PWD_RECENT1 ,PWD_RECENT2 ,PWD_ERR_CNT ) VALUES ( ?USER_ID ,?EMP_NO ,?USER_NAME ,(CASE WHEN ?CTI_AGENT_ID = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ?CTI_AGENT_ID END) ,?DEPT_CD ,?TEAMCD ,?TREATYHQCD ,?TREATYHQNM ,?TREATYBRHCD ,?TREATYBRHNM ,?TREATYDEPTCD ,?TREATYDEPTNM ,(CASE WHEN ?LINE_NO = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ?LINE_NO END) ,?LEVEL_CD ,?FUNCTION_CD ,?JOB_CD ,?WORK_GROUP_CD ,?USER_GRADE_CD ,?USER_GROUP_CD ,?ENTER_DATE ,?RETIRE_DATE ,?CALLAUTH ,(CASE WHEN ?WORK_MONTH = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ?WORK_MONTH END) ,?USE_YN ,?REGISTID ,?REGISTDATE ,?REGISTTIME ,?CHG_ID ,?CHGDATE ,?CHGTIME ,?SSOLOGINID ,?PASSWORD ,?PWD_CHG_DATE ,?PWD_RECENT1 ,?PWD_RECENT2 ,?PWD_ERR_CNT );

SELECT CASE CODETYPE WHEN 'SYS001' THEN 'SYS011' WHEN 'SYS999' THEN 'SYS001' END AS CODE_TYPE, CODE AS CODE_ID, CODENAME AS CODE_NAME, CASE CODETYPE WHEN 'SYS999' THEN ' ' WHEN 'SYS001' THEN NVL(ETCCODE1,' ') END AS ETC1, NVL(SORTKEY, 0) AS SORT_KEY FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE IN ('SYS999', 'SYS001') AND CODE <> '000000'

MERGE ms_codebook AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( CODE_TYPE = ?CODE_TYPE AND CODE_ID = ?CODE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CODE_NAME = ?CODE_NAME, ETC1 = (CASE WHEN ?CODE_TYPE = 'SYS011' THEN ?ETC1 WHEN ?CODE_TYPE = 'SYS001' THEN ETC1 END), SORT_KEY = (CASE WHEN ?SORT_KEY = 0 THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR,?SORT_KEY) END) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( CODE_TYPE ,CODE_ID ,CODE_NAME ,ETC1 ,USE_YN ,SORT_KEY ) VALUES ( ?CODE_TYPE ,?CODE_ID ,?CODE_NAME ,?ETC1 ,'Y' ,(CASE WHEN ?SORT_KEY = 0 THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR,?SORT_KEY) END) );

SELECT U.USERID AS USER_ID, CASE WHEN C.OPEN_INPUT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND C.LEAVEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(LEAVEDATE,0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(OPEN_INPUT_DATE,0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'))+1 WHEN C.OPEN_INPUT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND C.LEAVEDATE IS NULL THEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM')||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(OPEN_INPUT_DATE,0,6)||'01','YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD'))+1 ELSE 0 END AS WORK_MONTH FROM TSOWN.TB_USER U, TSOWN.TB_TMR_ID_CREATE C WHERE U.USERID = C.USERID(+)
UPDATE ms_usermaster SET WORK_MONTH = (CASE WHEN ?WORK_MONTH = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ?WORK_MONTH END) WHERE USER_ID = ?USER_ID

SELECT USER_ID, QACD, ALC_BRH_CD, IVST_PTCD, USE_YN, NVL(REGISTDATE,' ') AS REGISTDATE, NVL(REGISTID,' ') AS REGISTID, NVL(CHANGEDATE,' ') AS CHANGEDATE, NVL(CHANGEID,' ') AS CHANGEID, ALLO_NUM FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ALLOCATE_MNG WHERE 1=1 -- AND (CHANGEDATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD')) -- AND (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') - CHANGEDATE = 0 OR TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') - REGISTDATE = 0) AND (CHANGEDATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date OR REGISTDATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date)

MERGE tb_pre_est_allocate_mng AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( USER_ID = ?USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET QACD = ?QACD, ALC_BRH_CD = ?ALC_BRH_CD, IVST_PTCD = ?IVST_PTCD, USE_YN = ?USE_YN, REGISTDATE = ?REGISTDATE, REGISTID = ?REGISTID, CHANGEDATE = ?CHANGEDATE, CHANGEID = ?CHANGEID, ALLO_NUM = ?ALLO_NUM WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( USER_ID ,QACD ,ALC_BRH_CD ,IVST_PTCD ,USE_YN ,REGISTDATE ,REGISTID ,CHANGEDATE ,CHANGEID ,ALLO_NUM ) VALUES ( ?USER_ID ,?QACD ,?ALC_BRH_CD ,?IVST_PTCD ,?USE_YN ,?REGISTDATE ,?REGISTID ,?CHANGEDATE ,?CHANGEID ,?ALLO_NUM );

SELECT SC_CD, SC_CDNM, TYPE_CD, NVL(UPR_SC_CD,' ') AS UPR_SC_CD, USE_YN, RGTR_CRNO, REGN_DT AS REGN_DT, UPDR_CRNO, ALTR_DT AS ALTR_DT, NVL(TTS_USE_YN, ' ') AS TTS_USE_YN, NVL(VA_ESSN_YN, ' ') AS VA_ESSN_YN, NVL(COMM_YN, ' ') AS COMM_YN FROM TSOWN.TB_SC_CODE_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND (TO_CHAR(ALTR_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date OR TO_CHAR(REGN_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date )

MERGE tb_sc_code_mng AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( SC_CD = ?SC_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SC_CDNM = ?SC_CDNM, TYPE_CD = ?TYPE_CD, UPR_SC_CD = ?UPR_SC_CD, USE_YN = ?USE_YN, RGTR_CRNO = ?RGTR_CRNO, REGN_DT = format(?REGN_DT,'yyyyMMdd'), UPDR_CRNO = ?UPDR_CRNO, ALTR_DT = format(?ALTR_DT,'yyyyMMdd'), TTS_USE_YN = ?TTS_USE_YN, VA_ESSN_YN = ?VA_ESSN_YN, COMM_YN = ?COMM_YN WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( SC_CD ,SC_CDNM ,TYPE_CD ,UPR_SC_CD ,USE_YN ,RGTR_CRNO ,REGN_DT ,UPDR_CRNO ,ALTR_DT ,TTS_USE_YN ,VA_ESSN_YN ,COMM_YN ) VALUES ( ?SC_CD ,?SC_CDNM ,?TYPE_CD ,?UPR_SC_CD ,?USE_YN ,?RGTR_CRNO ,format(?REGN_DT,'yyyyMMdd') ,?UPDR_CRNO ,format(?ALTR_DT,'yyyyMMdd') ,?TTS_USE_YN ,?VA_ESSN_YN ,?COMM_YN );

SELECT ENTR_DSGN_NO, VRS_ITCD, VRS_OBSV_BART, round(VRS_OBSV_RATE,2,1) as VRS_OBSV_RATE, CASE WHEN VRS_OBSV_RATE >= VRS_OBSV_BART THEN SCORE2 ELSE 0 END AS VRS_ITCD_SCOR
FROM (
SELECT Q.ENTR_DSGN_NO, Q.VRS_ITCD, MAX(Q.VRS_OBSV_BART) AS VRS_OBSV_BART, MAX(Q.SCORE2) AS SCORE2, SUM(Q.VRS_OBSV_RATE)/COUNT(Q.QST_CD) AS VRS_OBSV_RATE FROM (
SELECT A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO as ENTR_DSGN_NO, A.SC_SCLF_CD as VRS_ITCD, A.QST_CD , A.SCRIPT_SENT_ID, MAX(B.ETC1) AS VRS_OBSV_BART, MAX(B.ETC2) AS SCORE2, MAX(A.SENT_SCORE) AS VRS_OBSV_RATE FROM ( SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO ,CNTR_CD ,SC_LCLF_CD ,SC_SCLF_CD ,QST_CD ,SCRIPT_SENT_ID ,CTRA_INSA_CLCD ,SENT_SCORE ,TA_SCORE , CHG_DATE FROM ms_regu_score r WITH(NOLOCK) --문장 준수한 테이블
UNION SELECT R.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ,R.CNTR_CD ,R.SC_LCLF_CD ,R.SC_SCLF_CD ,R.QST_CD ,R.SCRIPT_SENT_ID ,R.CTRA_INSA_CLCD ,0 SENT_SCORE ,0 TA_SCORE ,R.CHG_DATE FROM MS_REGU_OMIT R WITH(NOLOCK) --누락한 문장들 테이블
) A INNER JOIN ( SELECT C.CODE_ID, C.ETC1, C.ETC2, D.VA_ESSN_YN FROM ms_codebook C WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_sc_code_mng D WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.CODE_ID = D.SC_CD where C.CODE_TYPE = 'EST312' ) B ON A.SC_SCLF_CD = B.CODE_ID , ms_script_sent X WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.CHG_DATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date AND B.VA_ESSN_YN = 'Y'
AND A.SC_LCLF_CD = X.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD = X.SC_SCLF_CD AND A.QST_CD = X.QST_CD AND A.SCRIPT_SENT_ID = X.SCRIPT_SENT_ID AND A.CNTR_CD = X.CNTR_CD AND (X.EXCEPT_YN = 'N' OR X.EXCEPT_YN IS NULL) AND X.DEL_YN='N'
GROUP by A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, A.SC_SCLF_CD, A.QST_CD ,A.SCRIPT_SENT_ID
) Q
GROUP by ENTR_DSGN_NO, VRS_ITCD
) V
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY ENTR_DSGN_NO, VRS_ITCD

MERGE INTO TSOWN.TB_VA_VRS_OBSV_RSLT USING DUAL ON (ENTR_DSGN_NO = ?ENTR_DSGN_NO AND VRS_ITCD = ?VRS_ITCD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET VRS_OBSV_BART = ?VRS_OBSV_BART ,VRS_OBSV_RATE = ?VRS_OBSV_RATE ,VRS_ITCD_SCOR = ?VRS_ITCD_SCOR ,ALTR_DTM = SYSDATE ,UPDR_ID = 'VA' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TSOWN.TB_IVST_MTHD_HIST H WHERE H.ENT_DGN_NO = ?ENTR_DSGN_NO ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ENTR_DSGN_NO ,VRS_ITCD ,VRS_OBSV_BART ,VRS_OBSV_RATE ,VRS_ITCD_SCOR ,REGN_DTM ,RGTR_ID ) VALUES ( ?ENTR_DSGN_NO ,?VRS_ITCD ,?VRS_OBSV_BART ,?VRS_OBSV_RATE ,?VRS_ITCD_SCOR ,SYSDATE ,'VA' ) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TSOWN.TB_IVST_MTHD_HIST H WHERE H.ENT_DGN_NO = ?ENTR_DSGN_NO )

FROM (

SELECT A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO as ENTR_DSGN_NO, A.SC_SCLF_CD as VRS_ITCD, A.QST_CD , A.SCRIPT_SENT_ID, MAX(B.ETC1) AS VRS_OBSV_BART, MAX(B.ETC2) AS SCORE2, MAX(A.SENT_SCORE) AS VRS_OBSV_RATE FROM ( SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO ,CNTR_CD ,SC_LCLF_CD ,SC_SCLF_CD ,QST_CD ,SCRIPT_SENT_ID ,CTRA_INSA_CLCD ,SENT_SCORE ,TA_SCORE , CHG_DATE FROM ms_regu_score r WITH(NOLOCK) --문장 준수한 테이블
UNION SELECT R.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ,R.CNTR_CD ,R.SC_LCLF_CD ,R.SC_SCLF_CD ,R.QST_CD ,R.SCRIPT_SENT_ID ,R.CTRA_INSA_CLCD ,0 SENT_SCORE ,0 TA_SCORE ,R.CHG_DATE FROM MS_REGU_OMIT R WITH(NOLOCK) --누락한 문장들 테이블
) A INNER JOIN ( SELECT C.CODE_ID, C.ETC1, C.ETC2, D.VA_ESSN_YN FROM ms_codebook C WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_sc_code_mng D WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.CODE_ID = D.SC_CD where C.CODE_TYPE = 'EST312' ) B ON A.SC_SCLF_CD = B.CODE_ID , ms_script_sent X WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.CHG_DATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date AND B.VA_ESSN_YN = 'Y'
AND A.SC_LCLF_CD = X.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD = X.SC_SCLF_CD AND A.QST_CD = X.QST_CD AND A.SCRIPT_SENT_ID = X.SCRIPT_SENT_ID AND A.CNTR_CD = X.CNTR_CD AND (X.EXCEPT_YN = 'N' OR X.EXCEPT_YN IS NULL) AND X.DEL_YN='N'
GROUP by A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, A.SC_SCLF_CD, A.QST_CD , A.SCRIPT_SENT_ID
) Q
GROUP by ENTR_DSGN_NO, VRS_ITCD
) V
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY ENTR_DSGN_NO

UPDATE TSOWN.TB_VA_GRADE_RSLT SET VRS_CNVR_SCOR = ?VRS_CNVR_SCOR, ALTR_DTM = SYSDATE, UPDR_ID = 'VA' WHERE ENTR_DSGN_NO = ?ENTR_DSGN_NO AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TSOWN.TB_IVST_MTHD_HIST H WHERE H.ENT_DGN_NO = ?ENTR_DSGN_NO )

SELECT M.SC_SNO, M.PROD_CD, M.CTRA_INSA_CLCD, M.SC_LCLF_CD, M.HIST_VER, NVL(M.SC_CNTS,' ') AS SC_CNTS, M.SC_DESC, M.USE_YN, M.RGTR_CRNO, M.REGN_DT, M.UPDR_CRNO, M.ALTR_DT, M.CHNL_CLCD FROM TSOWN.TB_SC_MNG M ,TSOWN.TB_PROD_ATTR_MNG P WHERE M.PROD_CD = P.PROD_CD AND M.CHNL_CLCD = P.CHNL_CLCD AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.ALTR_DT BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date OR M.REGN_DT BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date ) ?chnl_clcd

SELECT ITEM_CD AS PROD_CD, ITEM_NAME AS PROD_NM, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(SAED_DATE, 5,1) NOT IN ('0', '1') AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(SAED_DATE,0,4) || '12', 'YYYYMM'),SYSDATE),0) >= 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN SUBSTR(SAED_DATE, 5,1) IN ('0', '1') AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(SAED_DATE,0,6), 'YYYYMM'),SYSDATE),0) >= 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END USE_YN, (ENTY_DATE || '000000') AS REG_DATE FROM TSOWN.TBIA101 WHERE 1=1 -- AND ENTY_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') -- AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') - ENTY_DATE = 0

MERGE ms_product AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( PROD_CD = ?PROD_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PROD_NM = ?PROD_NM, USE_YN = ?USE_YN, REG_DATE = ?REG_DATE, CHG_DATE = (format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss')) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( PROD_CD ,PROD_NM ,USE_YN ,REG_DATE ) VALUES ( ?PROD_CD ,?PROD_NM ,?USE_YN ,?REG_DATE );

SELECT D.ITEM_CD AS PROD_CD, D.DMBO_CD AS DMBO_CD, D.DMBO_NAME AS DMBO_NM, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P.SAED_DATE, 5,1) NOT IN ('0', '1') AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(P.SAED_DATE,0,4) || '12', 'YYYYMM'),SYSDATE),0) >= 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN SUBSTR(P.SAED_DATE, 5,1) IN ('0', '1') AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(P.SAED_DATE,0,6), 'YYYYMM'),SYSDATE),0) >= 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END USE_YN, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(D.APLY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DATE FROM TSOWN.TBIA102 D, TSOWN.TBIA101 P WHERE D.ITEM_CD = P.ITEM_CD -- AND D.ENTY_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') -- AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') - D.ENTY_DATE = 0

MERGE ms_dmbo AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( PROD_CD = ?PROD_CD AND DMBO_CD = ?DMBO_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DMBO_NM = ?DMBO_NM, USE_YN = ?USE_YN, REG_DATE = ?REG_DATE, CHG_DATE = (format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss')) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( PROD_CD ,DMBO_CD ,DMBO_NM ,USE_YN ,REG_DATE ) VALUES ( ?PROD_CD ,?DMBO_CD ,?DMBO_NM ,?USE_YN ,?REG_DATE );

SELECT M.SC_SNO, M.SC_LCLF_CD, M.SC_SCLF_CD, M.QST_CD, M.CNTR_CD, M.QST_CDNM, M.QST_CNTS, M.QST_KIND_CD, M.SORTKEY, M.DEL_YN, M.RGTR_CRNO AS REG_ID, M.REGN_DT AS REG_DATE, M.UPDR_CRNO AS CHG_ID, M.ALTR_DT AS CHG_DATE FROM TSOWN.TB_SC_QST_MNG M, TSOWN.TB_SC_MNG B, TSOWN.TB_PROD_ATTR_MNG C WHERE M.SC_SNO = B.SC_SNO AND M.SC_LCLF_CD = B.SC_LCLF_CD AND B.PROD_CD = C.PROD_CD AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND AND ( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_CHAR(M.ALTR_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = 0 OR TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_CHAR(M.REGN_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = 0 )

MERGE tb_sc_qst_mng AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( SC_SNO = ?SC_SNO AND SC_LCLF_CD = ?SC_LCLF_CD AND SC_SCLF_CD = ?SC_SCLF_CD AND QST_CD = ?QST_CD AND CNTR_CD = ?CNTR_CD ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET QST_CDNM = ?QST_CDNM, QST_CNTS = ?QST_CNTS, R_FLAG = 'N', UPDR_CRNO = ?UPDR_CRNO, QST_KIND_CD = ?QST_KIND_CD, SORTKEY = ?SORTKEY, DEL_YN = ?DEL_YN, REG_ID = ?REG_ID, REG_DATE = format(?REG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'), CHG_ID = ?CHG_ID, CHG_DATE = format(?CHG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( SC_SNO ,SC_LCLF_CD ,SC_SCLF_CD ,QST_CD ,CNTR_CD ,QST_CDNM ,QST_CNTS ,R_FLAG ,UPDR_CRNO ,QST_KIND_CD ,SORTKEY ,DEL_YN ,REG_ID ,REG_DATE ,CHG_ID ,CHG_DATE ) VALUES ( ?SC_SNO ,?SC_LCLF_CD ,?SC_SCLF_CD ,?QST_CD ,?CNTR_CD ,?QST_CDNM ,?QST_CNTS ,'N' ,?UPDR_CRNO ,?QST_KIND_CD ,?SORTKEY ,?DEL_YN ,?REG_ID ,format(?REG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') ,?CHG_ID ,format(?CHG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') );

UPDATE ms_holiday_info SET WEEK1 = 1, HOLIDAY1 = '*', DETAIL = ?DETAIL, CHG_DATE = format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHERE 1=1 AND (SOLAR LIKE CONCAT('____',?SOLAR) OR SOLAR LIKE ?SOLAR )

UPDATE A SET GRD_FLAG = B.GRD_FLAG FROM ms_stt_meta A, (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN GRD_FLAG = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'E' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN GRD_FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'N' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN GRD_FLAG = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'S' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN GRD_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS GRD_FLAG, CON_ENT_DGN_NO FROM (SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO, CASE WHEN TA_FLAG = 'E' THEN 'E' WHEN TA_FLAG = 'Y' AND GRD_FLAG = 'E' THEN 'N' WHEN TA_FLAG = 'T' AND DATEDIFF(MI,(CONVERT(DATETIME,SUBSTRING(TA_R_TIME,0,5)+'-'+SUBSTRING(TA_R_TIME,5,2)+'-'+SUBSTRING(TA_R_TIME,7,2)+' ' + SUBSTRING(TA_R_TIME,9,2)+':' +SUBSTRING(TA_R_TIME,11,2)+':'+ SUBSTRING(TA_R_TIME,13,2))),GETDATE()) >= 30 THEN 'E' ELSE GRD_FLAG END AS GRD_FLAG FROM ms_stt_meta WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE REG_DATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date ) RE GROUP BY CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) B WHERE A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND A.GRD_FLAG NOT IN ('Y', 'S') AND (A.TA_FLAG <> 'S' AND A.SRC_FLAG <> 'S' AND A.VRS_S_FLAG <> 'S' AND A.BAN_S_FLAG <> 'S' AND A.ASS_FLAG <> 'S') -- AND A.GRD_FLAG <> 'Y' AND A.REG_DATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date
UPDATE ms_stt_meta SET VRS_S_FLAG = 'N' WHERE GRD_FLAG = 'N' AND TA_FLAG = 'Y' AND VRS_S_FLAG = 'S' AND REG_DATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date
UPDATE MS_STT_BEF_META SET VA_FLAG = 'N' WHERE VA_FLAG = 'S' AND REG_DATE BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date

UPDATE ms_stt_meta SET ASS_USER_ID = ?TM_UPDATE_PRE_QA, ASS_R_TIME = ?TM_UPDATE_PRE_JUDGE_DATE, ASS_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO
SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO FROM ms_stt_meta with(nolock) WHERE SUBSTRING(REG_DATE,0,9) BETWEEN ?from_date AND ?to_date GROUP BY CON_ENT_DGN_NO

UPDATE ms_qc_work_stat SET END_TIME = '000000' ,WORK_TIME = DATEDIFF(ss,CONVERT(DATETIME,STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(WORK_DATE+START_TIME,9,0,' '),12,0,':'),15,0,':')), DATEADD(DAY,1,CONVERT(DATETIME,STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(WORK_DATE+'000000',9,0,' '),12,0,':'),15,0,':')))) ,CHG_ID = 'SYSTEM' ,CHG_DATE = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHERE WORK_DATE = ?from_date AND END_TIME IS NULL

SELECT pvt.WORK_DATE, pvt.USER_ID, ISNULL(pvt."0",0) AS W_DURATION, ISNULL(pvt."1",0) AS R_DURATION, ISNULL(pvt."2",0) AS S_DURATION, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CONVERT(INT,B.WORK_TIME)) FROM MS_QC_WORK_STAT B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE WORK_DATE = ?from_date AND END_TIME IS NOT NULL AND B.USER_ID = PVT.USER_ID GROUP BY USER_ID),'0') AS TOT_DURATION FROM (select A.USER_ID ,WORK_GUBUN ,ISNULL(SUM(CONVERT(INT,WORK_TIME)),0) WORK_TIME ,WORK_DATE FROM ms_qc_work_stat A WITH(NOLOCK),vw_usermaster B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1 AND WORK_DATE = ?from_date AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID GROUP BY A.USER_ID,WORK_GUBUN, WORK_DATE ) b PIVOT(SUM(WORK_TIME) FOR WORK_GUBUN IN ([0],[1],[2])) AS pvt

MERGE ms_qc_work_sum AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( WORK_DATE = ?WORK_DATE AND USER_ID = ?USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET W_DURATION = ?W_DURATION, R_DURATION = ?R_DURATION, S_DURATION = ?S_DURATION, TOT_DURATION = ?TOT_DURATION, CHG_DATE = (format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss')), CHG_ID = 'SYSTEM' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( WORK_DATE ,USER_ID ,W_DURATION ,R_DURATION ,S_DURATION ,TOT_DURATION ) VALUES ( ?WORK_DATE ,?USER_ID ,?W_DURATION ,?R_DURATION ,?S_DURATION ,?TOT_DURATION );
DELETE FROM ms_qc_work_stat WHERE WORK_DATE = ?from_date

MERGE ms_ins_timestamp_sum AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( WORK_DATE = ?WORK_DATE AND USER_ID = ?USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET W_DURATION = ?W_DURATION, TOT_DURATION = ?TOT_DURATION, CHG_DATE = (format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss')), CHG_ID = 'SYSTEM' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( WORK_DATE ,USER_ID ,W_DURATION ,TOT_DURATION ) VALUES ( ?WORK_DATE ,?USER_ID ,?W_DURATION ,?TOT_DURATION );
DELETE FROM ms_ins_timestamp WHERE WORK_DATE = ?from_date
